blocks.text: Log management and analytics without the infrastructure burden

Axiom reimagines log management for the serverless era. Instead of provisioning and managing Elasticsearch clusters, you send logs to Axiom's API and query them instantly. The serverless architecture means no capacity planning, no cluster management, and costs that scale linearly with usage.

The query language is powerful but accessible. Dashboard creation, log exploration, and alerting all use the same query syntax, reducing the learning curve for teams. The ability to query across all your log data without pre-defining indices or schemas eliminates the upfront work that traditional log platforms require.
For teams migrating from expensive ELK stack deployments or outgrowing basic log services, Axiom provides enterprise-grade log analytics at a fraction of the cost and operational burden.
Send logs via API - no cluster to manage
Store logs indefinitely without additional cost
Watch logs in real-time with live tail
SQL-like query language for exploration and analysis
Custom dashboards with charts, tables, and alerts
Vercel, Cloudflare Workers, AWS Lambda, and more

Axiom gives us enterprise-grade log analytics without the Elasticsearch management tax. The generous free tier and simple pricing make it accessible to startups while scaling to handle enterprise volumes.
Our engineers work with Axiom daily and can help you integrate it into your stack.
